description: Add one endpoint to an API that already exists, or a changed version of one of its endpoints. Use it when get_api shows the API lacks the data, or an endpoint returns the wrong thing. Existing endpoints never change: a change ships as a new endpoint beside the old one (e.g. /search-v2). Without `confirm` nothing is built: the tool answers with the endpoint as it would be built, for the user to agree to. Call it again with the same arguments and `confirm: true` to start the build (about half an hour). One build of an API runs at a time: a request made while another is building waits in line and starts on its own. Needs an API key with the requests:write permission. Follow the build with get_build_status.

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.

change.description: For a changed version of an existing endpoint: that endpoint's name or path, e.g. "/search". Use instead of `path`.

confirm.description: true starts the build. Leave it out to preview first.

description.description: What the endpoint returns, as specific as you can: the page it reads, the fields per record, the parameters. E.g. "The reviews of one hotel, newest first: author, rating, date, text. Parameter: hotel id."

path.description: For a new endpoint: its path, lowercase with dashes, no parameters in it. E.g. "/reviews" or "/hotel-photos".

name: request_endpoint
title: Ask for a new maviapi endpoint
